name: East Warren Crips
description: The East Warren Crips (EWC), also known as the East Warren Posse (EWP), are a Crip-affiliated street gang based on Detroit's east side, historically active along the East Warren Avenue corridor in the Fox Creek neighborhood (ZIP 48215), with an extended presence into the Core City area on the west side (ZIP 48208). Regarded as one of the earlier Crip-aligned formations on Detroit's east side, EWC maintains ties to the Playboy Gangster Crips and historical alignment with the Gangster Disciples. Members identify with blue colors, throw 'C' hand signs, and use six-point star graffiti tags. The group is documented in court records and law-enforcement reporting as a legacy east-side set.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of East Warren Posse (EWP) / East Warren Crips in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
